newsitem.title: CHINA: China backs Boutros-Ghali's U.N. re-election bid.
newsitem.headline: China backs Boutros-Ghali's U.N. re-election bid.

text.p: China on Monday threw its weight behind the re-election bid of United Nations Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
"China supports Boutros Boutros-Ghali's re-election as UN Secretary-General," the official Xinhua news agency said, quoting Foreign Ministry spokesman Cui Tiankai.
"China appraises positively the important work by Mr Boutros-Ghali to strengthen the role of the United Nations during his tenure as U.N. Secretary-General," Xinhua said.
China said it backed the stance by the Organisation of African Unity (OAU) on Boutros-Ghali's candidacy.
"The OAU's recommendation of Mr Boutros-Ghali for re-election is justified and we will support it," Cui said.
